delta: Extend the existing --reduce path from one JSON packet to file-or-directory sweep without creating a second reducer CLI.
Add repeatable --now-id / --selected-id / --reactivate-id caller context; batch contents cannot self-authorize NOW.
Add --converge <candidate.json> as an advisory contribution projection: DELTA / EVIDENCE / DONOR / RETURN / UNRESOLVED plus MERGE / REPAIR / HOLD / DROP.
Contribution convergence consumes caller-attested host, verification, mergeability and supersession facts only; it does not query GitHub or mutate CURRENT, branches, packets, or native hosts.
CI exercises fixtures plus the real control/packets shelf and requires zero implicit NOW.

Compose the #689 research donor gate into contribution reduction: external donor candidates with missing/non-PASS admission are DONOR/HOLD; PASS only removes that blocker and does not grant host/effect authority.
Contribution MERGE now requires caller-attested exact head, current base, mergeability, and passing verification; stale head/base reduce to REPAIR.

laws: ONE MACHINE ENTRYPOINT; MANY READ-ONLY REDUCTIONS.
THE REDUCER CLASSIFIES; IT DOES NOT PRIORITIZE, EXECUTE, MERGE OR MUTATE.
CONTRIBUTION DISPOSITION IS ADVISORY AND CALLER-ATTESTED; NATIVE HOST/GITHUB AUTHORITY REMAINS NATIVE.
ONE PACKET -> EXACTLY ONE OF NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT / ARCHIVE.
MERGE PROJECTION REQUIRES EXACT_HEAD + BASE_CURRENT + MERGEABLE + VERIFIED; ANY UNKNOWN/STALE BOUNDARY REPAIRS FIRST.
BASE_CURRENT IS ANCESTRY, NOT METADATA: native compare(master, candidate_head).behind_by MUST EQUAL 0; PR base-pointer equality alone does not establish currency.
residue: The contribution reducer does not fetch live GitHub state; mergeable/CI/superseded facts must be caller-attested or produced by a native GitHub worker.
MERGE output is not merge authority; it is a disposition projection after attested checks.
No automatic NEXT execution is introduced.
Research-donor-gate PASS is necessary only for external-donor admission; it never mints host ownership, CURRENT/NOW, effect permission, or merge authority.
The caller/native GitHub worker must derive base_current from commit ancestry (behind_by === 0), not from the PR base SHA field.
stop: Do not create another packet/contribution reducer CLI. Extend this entrypoint only for a reproduced consumer incompatibility or falsified invariant.
